item.title: Darkest Dungeon®: The Fire's Edge
item.description:
Title: Darkest Dungeon®: The Fire's Edge
Genre: Indie , RPG , Strategy
Developer: Red Hook Studios
Publisher: Red Hook Studios
Release Date: Aug 18, 2026




About This Content

“...we have each of us in the dustiest cellars of our minds a counter at which we strive to repay the debts of the past with the debased currency of the present.” - Gene Wolfe

Two more wayward souls wander the Old Road. The Duelist and Runaway, debuted in Darkest Dungeon II, bring their unique abilities to bear against horrors that lurk beneath the manor.
Patterned in burns, draped in tatters and wielding a crude poker, the vagrant Runaway favours fire and stealth when pressed to fight.
By contrast, the Duelist stands severe, her ornate capelet conspicuously pierced above the breast. No challenger has yet to hold quarter against her bitter edge.


Features:
  • Two new hero classes: the Duelist and the Runaway
  • Set the dungeon alight with Runaway’s new combat mechanic: Burn!
  • New Trinket Mechanics such as Trigger Uses, Quest Charges and Progressive Trinkets
  • 3 new Hamlet Districts: Academie Duello, Craftworks, and Archaeological Base Camp

The Runaway is a position-flexible damage dealer utilizing a unique Burn damage type with high synergy for teams that like to utilize Stuns and Pull/Knockback/Shuffle effects.

The Duelist is a complex damage dealer that dances between the party’s ranks, able to freely maintain Riposte while alternating between her two combat stances, Defensive and Aggressive. Proper planning of the Duelist’s future turns is key to mastering her playstyle and maximizing her potential!

Fans of both games will delight in this re-visioning of these two new iconic heroes for Darkest Dungeon.

item.title: Twisted Tower
item.description:
Title: Twisted Tower
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie
Developer: Atmos Games
Publisher: 3D Realms
Release Date: Aug 18, 2026




About This Game

Step right up to the Twisted Tower! Careful though! Our silly mascots may be looking for a hug, and our carnival rides might need some screws tightened…

So what do you say, chap? Are you tough enough to make it to the top of the tower and save the love of your life?

Here’s what your ticket will get you upon entering the magical resort:

  • Explore an abandoned 1950’s resort reminiscent of BioShock and Disney World

  • Get lost in 5 hauntingly beautiful levels: the hotel, the waterpark, the clown casino, the carnival forest, and the space station

  • Punchy, bloody gunplay with corrupted fairy-tale mascots

  • Immerse yourself in a mysterious and emotional story

  • Choose from a variety of unique paths per playthrough, ensuring the world feels like a fresh new experience

  • Upgrade your toyish arsenal, including: a whack-a mole mallet, rubber-band pistol, dart throwin’ Tommy Gun, fartin’ shotgun, bubblegum spittin’ chain-gun, sniper slingshot, skull-poppin’ ray gun, and more

  • Collect bizarre toys to assist you in jumping, dashing, and grappling your way up the tower

Mature Content Description

The developers describe the content like this:

Contains violence gore/blood splatter related to shooting and killing enemies/monstrous creatures.



System Requirements

Windows

    Minimum:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
    • Processor: i5-6600 / Ryzen 5 1600X
    • Memory: 8 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GTX 670 / RX 570 / Arc B580
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 8 GB available space
    Recommended:
    • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
    • OS: Windows 11
    • Processor: i5-8400 / R5 2600
    • Memory: 16 GB RAM
    • Graphics: GTX 1660 / Vega FE
    • DirectX: Version 11
    • Storage: 8 GB available space

item.title: Exark
item.description:
Title: Exark
Genre: Indie , Strategy
Developer: Robot Cat Limited
Publisher: Goblinz Publishing
Franchise: Goblinz Publishing
Release Date: Aug 18, 2026




About This Game

The world-machine is broken. The sun has become a baleful orb of radiation. The Celestial Bureaucracy is in disarray. You, the Captain-General of a great ark, must lead your people rimwards, away from the gaze of the green sun.

Optimize Your Production

Survive your voyage by maximising your production of valuable resources:

  • Food fuels your buildings, and stockpiles increase their cycle speed.

  • Production allows you to construct more buildings on your ever-expanding ark.

  • Inspiration enables you to hire crew members with unique skills to improve your buildings.

  • ... or buy buildings and hire crew members outright by spending Gold at the dockside markets.

Choose Your Great House

Pick between a range of Great Houses, each with their own unique ark, buildings and crewmates. Command House Arioch's golden flagship, the Diurnal Ark, and harness the expertise of their engineers and artisans - or choose House Mnesis, whose ark, the titanic Shepherd Moon, is a motherlode of precious raw materials.

Exploit the Houses' specialities, mitigate their shortcomings, and lead them to a safe refuge on the rim.

Key Features

  • Explore a vibrant world , with diverse biomes and settlements.

  • Command 4 unique Great Houses , each requiring a different strategy to reach victory.

  • Build your ultimate engine with over 100 buildings and specialized crew members.

  • Play at your own pace with pause and time acceleration.

  • Multiple routes to victory , either focusing on peaceful production or blasting your enemies into submission.

item.title: Entropy
item.description:
Title: Entropy
Genre: Action , Adventure , Indie , RPG , Early Access
Developer: Lovely Hellplace
Publisher: DreadXP
Release Date: Aug 18, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Aug 18, 2026




About This Game

In this dying age, only pockets of humanity remain. There was no apocalyptic event to speak of; only the cruel march of time and the inexplicable infertility of the world. Accursed creatures stalk the barren lands between settlements, which are themselves terrible places; squalid, medieval and mostly ruled by tyrants.

Our story begins in the town of Draenog, where the theatre performance you are putting on is interrupted by fighting at the gates. Demons have arrived. Your wooden sword will have to do for now, gather the troupe and defend yourselves!

Entropy is a post-apocalyptic role-playing game with an expansive world map, explorable towns filled with colorful characters, and a tactical turn-based battle system.

KEY FEATURES

  • Embark on a quest across the lands to stop the demonic incursion.

  • Control your party of up to 6 characters.

  • Hire Mercenaries to replace your fallen party members.

  • Tactical Turn-Based Combat.

  • Explore a world full of unique characters, creatures, challenges, and treasure.

  • Level up your characters, increase your stats, and unlock new perks.

  • A beautiful retro 3D aesthetic.

item.title: Stackmon
item.description:
Title: Stackmon
Genre: Adventure , Indie , Strategy
Developer: Riftpoint Entertainment
Publisher: Alibi Games
Release Date: Aug 18, 2026




About This Game

Stackmon is a creature-collecting adventure with a unique card-stacking twist. Discover and capture new creatures and stack them with resource and equipment cards to unlock even rarer items and effects. Build up your camp, explore a vibrant world, and take on rival Scout Leaders, as you uncover the dark mystery behind the Soot – a strange corruption spreading across the land.

Features

- Discover 100+ Stackmon including Evolutions, Rare and Legendary editions!

- 25+ different Buildings to construct and upgrade your home base

- 20+ Equipment and Item cards to buff your Stackmon and Scouts

- 7 unique biomes to explore, each with their own game altering mechanics

Drag and drop Stackmon, resources and items onto each other to form powerful combinations! Use your Stackmon to gather materials, craft items, automate tasks and battle other Stackmon. Grow and customize your Harmony base to unlock new recipes, upgrades, and abilities for your Stackmon.

Discover and collect over 100 rare and powerful Stackmon and train and evolve them into their more powerful forms. Search for wild Stackmon across the world of Gaia, open booster packs to expand your collection, and help Professor Pine in his dream of completing the Stackpedia!

Venture beyond your base and challenge other Scouts scattered across the world to prove your strength and rise your way through the ranks. Take on rival Scouts in strategic auto-battles, using equipment, abilities and elemental affinities to your advantage. Face off against powerful Scout Leaders and show the strength of Harmony!

A mysterious and dangerous force is spreading throughout Gaia, corrupting any Stackmon and Scout Leaders in its path... It's up to you and your Stackmon to find the source of the corruption, face the Soot and change the fate that approaches.
